title: Disappointed
body:
Another disappointing ADHD app. This is a carbon copy of fabulous by the same company. New coat of paint, 100 dollar subscription, same useless structure and feel good fluff to trick people into feeling good enough about themselves to keep paying without ever making any real progress.

No real ability to structure or build anything in here. All you do is read letters, watch cartoons and high five yourself. Absolutely not the app for adults who want to get anything done with their disability but an app for teenagers and self diagnosed young adults who want to feel special.

What a waste.
author: Sepiksu

title: You need to pay
body: You need to pay to use the app. AND WHAT IS WITH SOMEONES WHO DONT HAVE ENOUGH MONEY?
